qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in percentage points between the year-on-year growth rate of the baby diaper market size and the year-on-year increase in the penetration rate in 2023? Keep 1 decimal place. Answer: xx.xx percentage points
qa_pairs.explanation: The market size increased from 55.5 billion yuan in 2022 to 62.8 billion yuan in 2023. The year-on-year growth rate = (62.8 - 55.5) / 55.5 × 100 = 13.2%; the penetration rate increased from 85.2% to 88.6%, with a year-on-year increase of 3.4 percentage points; 13.2% - 3.4% = 9.8 percentage points.

qa_pairs.question: What is the ratio of the proportion of consumers who purchased diapers to the proportion of consumers who chose offline channels for purchasing in 2022? Keep 2 decimal places. Answer: xx.xx times
qa_pairs.explanation: The proportion of purchasing diapers 78.2% ÷ the proportion of offline channels 8.7% = 8.9885. Keeping 2 decimal places, it is 8.99 times.

qa_pairs.question: What is the product of the baby diaper penetration rate and the proportion of purchasing pull-up diapers in 2022? Keep 2 decimal places. Answer: xx.xx%
qa_pairs.explanation: The penetration rate 85.2% × the proportion of purchasing pull-up diapers 76.4% = 0.852 × 0.764 = 0.650928. Keeping 2 decimal places, it is 65.10%.
